title: Collagen matrix (mucoderm®) as an alternative for the treatment of gingival recessions
authors: Taba M; Suzuki K; Irie M; Faria P; Messora M; Palioto D; Souza S; Novaes Jr. A. 2018 Oct 8. Clin Oral Implant Res (29):17; p.315. eposter (Mansucript submitted)
supports: Clinical study from the botiss mucoderm (porcine collagen soft-tissue matrix) literature list — the product featured in it, which is not the same as the study being about the product, so check the design and the comparator before citing it as product evidence. Authors' conclusion, verbatim: “and Clinical Implications: In this preliminary short time evaluation, both treatments showed a significant reduction in recession height. Considering no significant differences were observed between CTG and PCM groups for recessions height, width and thickness of keratinized tissue, it can be speculated that mucoderm® can be used as an alternative to CTG for the treatment of gingival recessions” This records what the paper says, not what a rep may say: the sales wording still has to pass the claim tiers, and a study in one indication licenses nothing in another.
